Hi, Marcela. Thanks for your time. So, what does your consultancy do?
Hi, Ryan. I am the founder. My consultancy looks at a company’s data and turns it into actionable marketing.
Interesting. We sell furniture online, and we spend a lot on paid media. But sales don’t grow.
I see. How do you track your results today?
Honestly, we don’t track much. My team looks at the ads, but nobody looks at the leads.
That is very common. Who talks to the leads after a campaign?
The sales team calls them, but they don’t use a CRM. They use a spreadsheet.
OK. So the first step is simple: we organize your data, and then we plan for growth.
I'm the founder of a growth marketing consultancy.
We track the results of every campaign.
How do you track your leads today?

Hello, I'm Arjun, and I am the founder of a small startup in Bangalore. My company makes an app for small restaurants. The app takes online orders, so the restaurant doesn't need a big delivery platform. Today about eight hundred restaurants use the app. My partner, Meera, writes the code, and I talk to the clients. Our product is good, but our marketing is weak. We don't have a marketing team, and we don't track our campaigns. So what do we need? We need more leads, and we need to understand our data. That is why I want to talk to a growth consultancy.

Hi, my name is Katrin. I am the CRM manager at an online fashion store in Hamburg, in Germany. My team has four people. Every week we send emails to more than a million customers. But the emails are only the first step. We track everything: who opens the email, who clicks, and who buys. Our data analyst, Jonas, prepares the numbers. I read them and decide the next campaign. My director doesn't want long reports. Every Friday she asks for a short report, one page, with actionable ideas. What does actionable mean for her? It means: tell me what to do on Monday.
